build_eval_args: build evaluation configs from pre-training configs and evaluation YAML paths for slurm batch processing
create_load_checkpoint: create a function that loads encoder, predictor, target encoder, optimizer, and scaler state from a checkpoint file
init_video_model: initialize a video vision transformer encoder and predictor model with configurable patch size, tubelet size, and activation settings
init_opt: initialize AdamW optimizer with warmup cosine learning rate scheduler and cosine weight decay schedule for training
run_load_checkpoint: run checkpoint loading to restore encoder, predictor, target encoder, optimizer, and gradient scaler state from disk
